{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH
df_new_paid_search = df[(df['channel'] == 'paid_search') & (df['customer_segment'] == 'new')]

# Check the number of records
n_total = len(df_new_paid_search)

# Check the number of converted customers
n_converted = df_new_paid_search['converted'].sum()

# Calculate the fraction
fraction_converted = n_converted / n_total

# Print the fraction
print(fraction_converted)"}
